seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Open seat: incumbent Treasurer Fiona Ma is the Lieutenant Governor nominee. Hawks's designation is left null because sources conflict. Summaries of the general certified list and a Fresno County general-election list give Retired Business Executive. The SoS primary voter guide and the primary certified list give Retired Businesswoman. One jumbled primary-notice snippet showed Businessman/Author/Father, which is probably another candidate's. Kounalakis's designation (Lieutenant Governor of California) comes from a single search summary of the certified list. One contact-list extraction placed Hawks under the Lieutenant Governor heading, which appears to be an artifact. Primary results per a summary of SoS unofficial results: Kounalakis about 37%, Hawks about 24%. Gap: the search budget ran out before Kounalakis's education and earlier career (e.g., U.S. ambassador service) or Hawks's education could be researched. Those facts are not recorded and need follow-up.
